commits.message:
fix(ci): resolve Node from engines where the job runs src/ (rich-workflows-0pr.2) (#126)

Three workflows resolved Node three ways: ci.yml read the version file,
publish.yml carried one workflow-level pin, deploy.yml hardcoded 20. The
rule now applied is not "point everything at engines" — it is that
`engines.node` and "which Node runs this job" are two different facts, and
the version file is the right authority only where the job executes the
package's own code.

By that rule:

- deploy.yml reads the version file. It compiles src/ (docs:build bundles
  examples/ through the demo tsconfig), so it must run a supported Node.
  The `20` it replaces encoded no constraint — it cleared vite's `^20.19.0`
  floor only because setup-node resolves a bare major to its newest patch.
- publish.yml's gate job reads the version file. The same gate means the
  same runtime, not just the same step list; re-gating a release under a
  different Node than master ran is a different experiment.
- publish.yml's publish job keeps an explicit `22`, now with its actual
  authority named. It never executes src/ — `npm run build` runs in the
  gate job and dist/ arrives as an artifact — so it is not a runtime the
  package must support. It runs the npm CLI, whose constraint is
  `^20.17.0 || >=22.9.0`, and `semver.subset(">=20", that)` is false:
  Node 20.5 and every 21.x satisfy engines and are refused by npm 11.

That dissolves the shared `env: NODE_VERSION`, which stood for two facts at
once. Its stated justification — "the gate vouching for a runtime the
tarball never met" — did not hold either way: the tarball's contents are
compiled in the gate job.

checkout and setup-node are aligned on v7 across all three files (they were
v4/v4/v6). v7 is the target rather than the incumbent v6 because it stops
exporting a dummy NODE_AUTH_TOKEN beside `registry-url`
(actions/setup-node#1558) — a placeholder landing a non-functional token in
.npmrc on precisely this OIDC publish path, which publish.yml already spends
five lines warning hands off. setup-node v5's auto-cache-by-packageManager
change is inert here: package.json declares no `packageManager` field.
checkout v7's fork-PR restriction applies only to `pull_request_target` and
`workflow_run`, neither of which any workflow here uses.

Also repairs a comment in ci.yml that this change falsified: it cited
"publish.yml pins Node 22 and publishes" as evidence that nothing checks the
tarball under the lowest admitted Node. The claim still holds; the evidence
now reads correctly.

Verified: actionlint clean on all four workflows; npm run lint clean; 2471
unit tests pass. The publish path itself remains unexercised — its one real
run failed at the registry — which is rich-workflows-0pr.3.
